entities.name: Query Psd1-like protein
observations: 545 aa sequence; predicted molecular weight 60.9 kDa and basic pI 9.17.
Shows PS_Dcarbxylase Pfam domains at residues 202–262 and 350–541.
Homologous to reviewed fungal mitochondrial phosphatidylserine decarboxylase proenzymes with 44.3–46.5% identity and strong coverage.
Likely undergoes autocatalytic processing to generate beta and pyruvoyl-containing alpha chains; exact cleavage residue is inferred from homologs, not directly experimentally mapped in this query.

entities.name: Phosphatidylserine decarboxylation
observations: This converts phosphatidylserine to phosphatidylethanolamine in phospholipid metabolism.

entities.name: Pyruvoyl cofactor
observations: A covalently bound pyruvoyl group is the catalytic cofactor in phosphatidylserine decarboxylase homologs.
The pyruvoyl group is generated by autocatalytic cleavage of a serine residue in the proenzyme.
